content:
id: drive_trash_probe
description: |
  WRITE — trash the disposable folder named "COMSTAR harness probe" if it exists.
  Run after drive_create_folder_probe when cleaning up. Uses trash, not permanent delete.
expected_output: >
  Spoken confirmation it was trashed / not found, or scope / connect-Google message.
  Must not claim permanent delete.
assertions:
  - type: min_chars
    value: 20
  - type: forbids_regex
    pattern: '(?i)(permanently deleted|deleted forever)'
fixtures:
  inject_transcript: >
    Find the Google Drive folder named COMSTAR harness probe and move it to the trash.
    Do not permanently delete it.
